summary: Cover unit semantic judgments produced for the 湖南农业大学 本科毕业论文 封面模板. Block 1 (附件1 封面基本格式…) is treated as a style-only format preamble that sits above the cover layout. Each visible cover text fragment is broken into parts distinguishing fixed school labels, fill slots for student-supplied values, and inline style/format instructions (e.g., font, spacing, alignment) that must be retained as style obligations. Fill slots are bound to vocabulary fields (thesis.title.zh, thesis.title.en, author.name.zh, author.student_id, author.cohort_class, advisor.name.zh, advisor.title, author.department, submission.date) where allowed. The school's example value "教授" in the advisor line is split out as a fill_slot for advisor.title (allowed_part_roles include fill_slot). No generated_content, body_structure, or manual_region parts are emitted; the cover is a fillable layout, not a terminal manual form.

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中论文不要。

semantic_judgments.reason: Format preamble sitting above the cover layout; it carries style obligations (page margins, line spacing, centering rule, the □ spacing symbol definition, and the 论文/设计 title-toggle rule) rather than cover content. No fill slot or label; preserved as style contract.
Inline format instruction telling the host to insert one blank line in 一号华文行楷 before the university name. No cover content; pure style/spacing requirement.

parts.text: 湖 南 农 业 大学

semantic_judgments.reason: University name is a fixed school label; the parenthetical is a font/size/bold style obligation attached to it, retained separately so the host keeps both the text and its style requirement.

parts.text: 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计)

semantic_judgments.reason: Fixed document type label for an undergraduate thesis/design; the parenthetical specifies 一号黑体加粗 and stays as a style-only obligation.
Inline format instruction: insert a blank line in 一号黑体 before the Chinese title. Pure style/spacing requirement.

parts.text: 毕业论文（设计）中文题目

semantic_judgments.reason: The "毕业论文（设计）中文题目" segment occupies the title's position; per the preamble's 论文/设计 rule, the actual value comes from thesis.title.zh. The trailing parenthetical carries the 小二黑体加粗 style obligation and is kept as style-only.

"TITLE OF GRADUATION PAPER" is the uppercase English title placeholder; bound to thesis.title.en (allowed_part_roles include fill_slot). The parenthetical is a 四号Times New Roman加粗大写 style requirement retained separately.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Spacing rule tied to the English title line (insert 2 or 3 blank lines in 四号 size based on title length). Pure layout/style requirement.

Leading spacing, label "学生姓名", and the inline "（三号黑体加粗）" attached to the label are fixed. The "×××（或×□×）" is the name example showing 2-character or 3-character names; it occupies the value slot for author.name.zh. The trailing "（三号楷体加粗）" is the style obligation for the value area, kept as style-only.
Label "学号" with leading indentation is fixed; the 12-digit example is the student ID slot bound to author.student_id.
Label "年级专业及班级" is fixed; the example "20××级×××（×）班" is the composite grade/major/class value slot bound to author.cohort_class (which exists in vocabulary for exactly this composite role).

Label "指导老师及职称" is fixed. The example value "×××□教授" combines a name placeholder, one □ spacing, and a title example; per skill rules adjacent values for different fields must be split. Name → advisor.name.zh (allowed fill_slot); the □ is the spacing symbol defined in the preamble and is a layout token, kept as style_only; "教授" → advisor.title (allowed fill_slot). The skill note "职称不应在无来源时自动补写" applies at materialization time; the slot here only reserves a position.

Label "学院" is fixed; the "××××学院" example is the value slot bound to author.department. The trailing parenthetical requires using the full department name; retained as a style/content rule on the slot.
Layout instruction: insert 2 or 3 blank lines in 三号 size before the location/date area. Pure style/spacing requirement.
Fixed school location "湖南·长沙"; the parenthetical "（小三号黑体）" is the style obligation for this line, retained as style-only.
Label "提交日期" is fixed; the example "20××年××月" occupies the value slot bound to submission.date (allowed fill_slot).
